sections.content: How many people are "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers"?

6,135 people

were counted on the census as "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" in England and Wales in March 2021.
TV, video and audio engineers install, service and repair domestic television, video and audio appliances.

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" there were more men than women (95.1% compared with 4.9%).

This means "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" had a similar proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "skilled metal, electrical and electronic trades".

Men made up 95.1% and women made up 4.9% of "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" included:

  • metal plate workers, smiths, moulders and related occupations
  • electrical engineers
  • window cleaners

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

People who had this job were generally similar in age to the working population

The occupation of "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 35 to 39 years. Of the whole working population 11.5% were aged 35 to 39 years. For people working as "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers", 12.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers" included:

  • biological scientists
  • publicans and managers of licensed premises
  • estimators, valuers and assessors

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "TV, video and audio servicers and repairers", 9.7% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had a similar age profile compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (76.2% compared with 23.8%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (60%) than self-employed (40%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Buckinghamshire, this is in the same region of the South East.
